Part One
Northern Tanzania
Days 1 – 7  ·  23 – 29 December 2026

From a coffee plantation in Moshi to the vast golden plains of the Serengeti and the ancient bowl of Ngorongoro — eleven days tracing one of Africa's most spectacular wildlife landscapes.

Geneva → Kilimanjaro Day 01
Wed 23 Dec 2026

Departure — Geneva to Kilimanjaro

Evening departure from Geneva at 22:15. Overnight flight via Addis Ababa, arriving at Kilimanjaro International Airport on December 24th at 10:45am.

Stay In-flight
Dinner
Serengeti · Days 02 – 05 The Serengeti Loop
Dec 24 – 28, 2026  ·  4 nights

Four Days Across the Serengeti Ecosystem

A moving camp through three distinct areas of the Serengeti — from the lake shores of Ndutu in the south to the great plains of the centre and the wild north. Daily game drives tracking predators and the great migration, with Christmas Eve and Christmas Day in the Serengeti.

Camp 01 · Southern Serengeti
Serengeti Ndutu Camp
Lake Ndutu · Plains setting
Camp 02 · Central Serengeti
Zawadi Tented Camp
Seronera Valley · Predator territory
Camp 03 · Northern Serengeti
Mawe Tented Camp
Lobo Area · Mara River corridor
Serengeti → Ngorongoro Day 06
Mon 28 Dec 2026

Drive to Ngorongoro — Safari Walk

Morning drive south from the Serengeti to the Ngorongoro Crater — the world's largest intact volcanic caldera. Afternoon safari walk along the crater rim with a ranger guide. Settle in at camp with sweeping views over the crater floor.

Stay Embalakai Ngorongoro Camp
B / L / D
Ngorongoro Day 07
Tue 29 Dec 2026

Ngorongoro Crater Safari & Drive to Arusha

Full game drive inside the Ngorongoro Crater — lions, elephants, flamingos and black rhinos in a single remarkable bowl. One of Africa's most concentrated wildlife experiences. In the afternoon, drive north to Arusha for a final night in Tanzania before departing for Kigali tomorrow.

Stay Aron's Farm Lodge, Arusha
B / L / D
© Rafael Barakat
Part Two
Rwanda & Uganda — Gorillas of Bwindi
Days 8 – 11  ·  30 December 2026 – 02 January 2027

From Kigali's vibrant streets, cross into the mist-cloaked forests of southwestern Uganda — where a life-changing encounter with the mountain gorillas of Bwindi forms the unforgettable crescendo of the journey.

Arusha → Kigali Day 08
Wed 30 Dec 2026

Fly to Kigali, Rwanda

Morning visit to the Cultural Heritage Centre in Arusha. Transfer to Kilimanjaro Airport for the 15:10 flight to Kigali. Arrive at 17:50 and check in to Eagle View Lodge. Evening at leisure before tomorrow's drive to Bwindi.

Stay Eagle View Lodge, Kigali
B / D
Kigali → Bwindi Day 09
Thu 31 Dec 2026

Drive to Bwindi Impenetrable NP

Scenic drive from Kigali to Bwindi Impenetrable National Park in southwestern Uganda, crossing the border through the highlands. Arrive at your forest-edge lodge for a New Year's Eve dinner and gorilla trek briefing.

Stay Bwindi Forest Lodge (TBC)
B / L / D
Bwindi NP → Kigali Day 10
Fri 01 Jan 2027

Mountain Gorilla Trek & Return to Kigali

An extraordinary start to the New Year. Brief at park HQ, then trek through dense rainforest for a life-changing hour with a habituated mountain gorilla family. Return to the lodge, then drive back to Kigali.

Stay Eagle View Lodge, Kigali
B / L / D
Kigali → Geneva Day 11
Sat 02 Jan 2027

Kigali & International Departure

A morning to explore Kigali — visit the Genocide Memorial or stroll through the city's markets and cafés. Transfer to the airport for your flight home departing at 5:40pm. Arrival in Geneva on Sunday 3rd January at 6:15am. Thank you for travelling with Kabani Safaris.

Your Guides

Two Extraordinary
Local Experts

Two extraordinary local guides anchor your journey — Ahadi in Tanzania and Keneth in Uganda. Each brings deep regional knowledge, language fluency and a personal connection to the wildlife and communities you'll encounter.

Tanzania
Days 1 – 11

Ahadi Musa Msuya

Ahadi is from the Kilimanjaro region and belongs to the Pare tribe. With over 16 years of experience guiding safaris across Tanzania, he studied mammal science and natural park conservation at the African Wildlife College in Moshi. His deep knowledge of the land — from the vast Serengeti to the volcanic shores of Lake Natron — gives travellers an unparalleled window into Tanzania's wildlife and ecosystems.

English Swahili Spanish Italian
Uganda
Days 12 – 15

Keneth Gumisiriza

Keneth is a Uganda-based safari operator who leads private journeys across East Africa — Uganda, Rwanda, Kenya and Tanzania. From the mountain gorillas of Bwindi to the chimpanzee forests of Kibale, Keneth pairs iconic wildlife with the warmth of community and culture. Travellers consistently note his attention to detail, calm pace and long-standing relationships with conservation areas across the region.

English French Kinyarwanda Luganda
